second_audit.chain_closure_explanation: Exact coefficient algebra establishes the common jet, derivative bounds, and endpoint separation. The retained one-hop authority supplies strict local-block monotonicity from the positive variance identity with the same normalization.
second_audit.claim_scope: For arbitrary rational a >= 0 and fixed c = 1/10^7, the rational-polynomial witnesses on beta in [0,6] share their Taylor jet through degree five, have derivatives at least 1, separate by 729/156250 at beta = 6, and remain strictly ordered after local one-plaquette composition.
second_audit.load_bearing_step: Because f_+ - f_- = c beta^6 with c > 0, while both derivatives are at least 1 on [0,6], the witnesses share the degree-five jet, separate by c 6^6 at the endpoint, and strict increase of P_1plaq preserves their order.
second_audit.verdict_rationale: Independent rational arithmetic confirms both endpoint values, the exact separation 729/156250, and the stated derivative endpoint checks; coefficient nonnegativity proves the interval bounds for every allowed a. The authority proves strict monotonicity using P_1plaq'(x) = Var_x(X) > 0 under the same observable normalization, while the two numerical local-block evaluations are support rather than imported physical inputs. The theorem therefore closes on its explicitly limited finite-jet and local-composition surface without asserting a full-Wilson realization or physical P(6) value.
